resources.string: Open ClipDrop on your PC, choose Pair device, and scan the QR code it shows.
Point your camera at the QR code that ClipDrop shows on your PC.
ClipDrop uses the camera only to read the pairing QR code. Nothing is recorded or sent anywhere.
This phone and %1$s will trust each other. Only pair with a PC you own.
You can now send your clipboard and files between this phone and your PC.
That QR code isn\'t a ClipDrop pairing code.
This pairing code comes from a newer version of ClipDrop. Update the app on this phone.
ClipDrop needs access to your local network to reach your PC. Your data never leaves your Wi-Fi.
Your phone and PC are on different networks. Connect both to the same Wi-Fi and try again.
The PC didn\'t answer. Check that Windows Firewall allows ClipDrop on private networks.
ClipDrop isn\'t running on the PC, or it\'s using a different port.
The device that answered isn\'t the PC that showed this code.
The PC refused the secure connection. If this phone was unpaired on the PC, pair again.
Something went wrong talking to the PC. Make sure both apps are up to date.
This version of ClipDrop can\'t talk to the one on your PC. Update both apps.
The code expired. Show a new one on the PC.
That code isn\'t valid any more. Show a new one on the PC.
Pairing isn\'t open on the PC. Click Pair device again.
The PC no longer recognises this phone. Pair again.
